sentences.text: The present petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 Cr.P.C. by the petitioners for quashing of FIR No. 362/2021, under Section 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at Police Station Chhawala, New Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that during the pendency of the trial, the parties have settled the matter amicably in terms of the Settlement Deed dated 04.02.2023 before the Principal Judge, Family Court, Dwarka, New Delhi.
A copy of the said Settlement Deed is placed on record.

Accordingly, the petition under Section 13-B(2) of the HMA was allowed and the marriage of the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 was dissolved vide decree dated 25.04.2023 passed by the learned Principal Judge, Family Courts, Dwarka Court, New Delhi.

sentences.text: The copy of the decree is already on record.
4. Petitioners and Respondent No.2 are present in Court and they have been identified by the IO.
I have interacted with the parties and they submit that they have settled their disputes.
Respondent No.2 admits that she has settled the matter amicably with the petitioners.
She further submits that the settlement/compromise has taken place voluntarily, without any force, pressure or coercion.
As per settlement, today, a demand draft of Rs. 2,90,000/- (bearing no. 773754 dated 18.05.2023 drawn on Indian Overseas Bank) has been handed over to respondent no.2.
Respondent No.2 submits that nothing remains to be adjudicated further between them and she has no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.
5. Learned ASC for the State submits that in view of the settlement, the State has no objection if the FIR in question is This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 08/10/2023 at 07:03:29 quashed.
6. Keeping in view the above facts and circumstances, since the matter has been amicably settled between the parties, no useful purpose will be served by keeping the case pending.
It will be nothing but abuse of the process of law.

Consequentially, this petition is allowed and FIR No. 362/2021,
under Section 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at Police Station Chhawala, New Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom shall stand quashed.
7.
The present petition stands disposed of accordingly.
